metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently overestimates prices after recent spikes, especially in the 10-15 day horizon; apply downward adjustment of 2-5% for post-spike periods.
- Forecast mean reverts too slowly; if true outcome shows sharp decline after peak, reduce forecast slope by 15-30% in next 5-7 days.
- Sentiment history is neutral (all 0.00) — no behavioral signal to override model; treat as baseline, but flag if true outcome deviates >10% from 30d forecast mean.
- Horizon-specific error: 30d forecasts often overshoot early in the period (first 5-7 days), then gradually correct — adjust first 5 days downward by 3-8% if true outcome is lower than forecast.
- If true outcome shows sustained upward trend after forecast peak, model underestimates future upside — increase forecast by 1-3% per additional day beyond peak.
- No event context provided — assume no exogenous shocks; do not adjust for news unless sentiment changes (currently all 0.00).
